--- ## Walkthrough This PR updates three CustomResourceDefinition manifests to promote `v1` as the storage version across volume group snapshot resources, while maintaining `v1beta2` as a served non-storage version. The `v1beta1` API version is explicitly disabled in OCP policy comments. The `volumegroupsnapshotcontents` CRD includes substantial schema updates with new field definitions and validation rules. The webhook configuration is updated to support the new API versions. ## Changes **CRD API Versioning Migration** | Layer / File(s) | Summary | |---|---| | **volumegroupsnapshotclasses versioning and v1beta2 schema**
`assets/volumegroupsnapshotclasses.yaml` | OCP policy comment updated; v1beta2 version entry renamed to v1 (storage version); new v1beta2 version block added with `served: true, storage: false`, including additionalPrinterColumns and openAPIV3Schema with immutability validations for deletionPolicy, driver, and parameters. | | **volumegroupsnapshotcontents versioning and v1 schema update**
`assets/volumegroupsnapshotcontents.yaml` | OCP policy comment updated; v1 schema significantly expanded to define status.volumeSnapshotInfoList and include enhanced validation rules for driver immutability and volumeGroupSnapshotRef constraints (name, namespace, uid immutability); v1beta2 storage flag changed to false. | | **volumegroupsnapshots versioning and v1beta2 schema**
`assets/volumegroupsnapshots.yaml` | OCP policy comment updated; v1beta2 version entry renamed to v1 (storage version); new v1beta2 version block defined with `served: true, storage: false`, including additionalPrinterColumns, subresources.status, and full openAPIV3Schema. | | **Webhook configuration for new API versions**
`assets/webhook_config.yaml` | volumegroupsnapshotclasses webhook rule updated to advertise apiVersions v1beta2 and v1 instead of v1alpha1. | ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes ## Suggested reviewers - dobsonj - RomanBednar
